cards.card_text: Moses says this will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry, and the LORD will never be willing to forgive that man.
cards.verse_text: because when such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself, saying, ‘I will have peace, even though I walk in the stubbornness of my own heart.’ This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry. The LORD will never be willing to forgive him. Instead, His anger and jealousy will burn against that man, and every curse written in this book will fall upon
